name: Engineering & Computing
description: Design, build and program the systems the world runs on, from bridges and power grids to software and AI.

name: Natural Sciences
description: Study how the natural world works through experiments, data and theory: physics, chemistry, biology and earth sciences.

name: Health Sciences & Medicine
description: Prepare to diagnose, treat and care for people: medicine, nursing, pharmacy and allied health professions.

name: Business & Management
description: Learn how organisations make, spend and report money, and how to lead them: accounting, finance, economics and management.

name: Arts & Humanities
description: Explore language, culture, history and ideas, and learn to argue, write and create with them.
